vector_memory.semantic_summary: This utility module provides a forgiving XML parser designed specifically for ingesting structured data like COLLADA files. It transforms raw XML strings into an in-memory representation defined by the XmlElement interface, handling nested structures, attributes, and special content like CDATA. The core logic uses an iterative, stack-based approach to parse the input string without relying on a full DOM, making it suitable for both browser and Node environments.
